name: git-diff-timeline
description: Git Diff timeline above the prompt: click a commit to see it, click two to compare them, with their commit messages; a Branches tab compares two branches; a GitHub-style files view shows each file's diff. Works with any git remote.

position.title: Where Git Diff shows
position.description: band: a strip above the prompt in every git repository; clicking a commit opens the files view beside the chat. pane: everything in the side pane, which opens itself.
